_about: Neon Hub's own words for the mook pack (stats are Corgo's, in mooks.json). desc: the actor's description. look: the art brief, added to the faction's style.

Aldecaldos.blurb: The biggest nomad family on Night City's edge, riding in from the Badlands for work.
Aldecaldos.style: a desert nomad clan rider: a padded two-tone road jacket in orange and navy or blue and black with reinforced shoulders, a utility harness, goggles or a headset pushed up, dusty trousers, sunburnt skin

Animals.blurb: A gang that worships raw muscle, fed on hormone cocktails and grafted bone.
Animals.style: a member of a muscle-worshipping street gang: a grotesquely huge, beefy body of steroid-swollen muscle with thick veins and a bull neck, dressed in gym and fight gear

Arasaka.blurb: The Japanese megacorp's security arm, from lobby guards to cyberninjas.
Arasaka.style: one single operative of a Japanese megacorporation's security force, dressed in its black and crimson-red colours, clean and well equipped

Barghest.blurb: Kurt Hansen's militia, the deserter army that holds Dogtown.
Barghest.style: a soldier of a warlord's militia in dark grey-black combat fatigues and body armor splashed and spray-painted with acid yellow-green paint, wearing a hi-vis yellow-green plate carrier with a white name tape on the chest, grey shoulder plates and worn black gloves

Generics.blurb: Security for hire, guarding whatever the client pays for.
Generics.style: a private security contractor: plain grey and navy uniform with a cheap armor vest, an earpiece and a peaked cap

Kang Tao.blurb: The Chinese smartgun maker's own security, as sharp as its guns.
Kang Tao.style: a security trooper of a Chinese arms megacorporation: a black bodysuit under bright orange armor made of hexagonal plates, an orange helmet with a white faceplate and sensor cluster

Lazarus Group.blurb: A private military company that hires out special forces.
Lazarus Group.style: a private military operator: matte black and slate tactical armor, a full-face respirator helmet, professional special-forces kit

Maelstrom.blurb: Chrome-mad gangers who carve out their own eyes to join.
Maelstrom.style: a member of a chrome-obsessed gang: the face replaced by a cluster of glowing red camera lenses set in bare metal, a scarred bare torso with exposed cables and bolted implants, a ripped leather vest and harness straps, dark grimy jeans

Max-Tac.blurb: The NCPD's psycho squad, chromed killers sent to stop chromed killers.
Max-Tac.style: an officer of an elite police tactical unit: glossy black heavy tactical armor with a high collar, a rounded full-face black helmet with a narrow visor, small blue status lights

Mercs.blurb: Freelance edgerunners, from first-gig blazers to near-legends.
Mercs.style: a freelance street mercenary: personal streetwear mixed with armor pieces, visible cyberware, a confident street-hardened look

Militech.blurb: America's arms giant and its corporate army.
Militech.style: a soldier of an American arms megacorporation: olive and black camouflage fatigues under an olive-yellow armor vest with pouches, a combat helmet with goggles, a black face mask

Ncpd.blurb: Night City's police, from beat cops to SWAT.
Ncpd.style: a city police officer: a navy blue uniform with a dark blue armor vest, a silver badge, a police cap or riot helmet, a radio on the shoulder

Netwatch.blurb: The Net's police, as dangerous in meatspace as in it.
Netwatch.style: an agent of a net security agency: a sharp black suit under a long dark coat, dark glasses, slicked hair, a cold investigator's stare, faint gold circuitry at the temple

Nusa.blurb: The New United States' deniable operatives.
Nusa.style: a government black-ops operative: unmarked black stealth armor, night-vision optics, no insignia

Scavengers.blurb: Chrome thieves who strip victims for parts.
Scavengers.style: a member of an organ-harvesting street gang with an Eastern European look: a worn leather jacket or blue track jacket, a flat cap or greasy hair, gold chain, surgical cyber-optics, stained hands

Trauma Team.blurb: The armored ambulance service that only saves subscribers.
Trauma Team.style: an armored combat medic of an elite ambulance corporation: a teal-green armored suit with white chest rig and pouches, red gloves, a white full-face helmet with a red visor light

Tyger Claws.blurb: Japantown's yakuza-style gang, blades, bikes and neon tattoos.
Tyger Claws.style: a member of a Japanese street gang, with colourful traditional irezumi tattoos of koi, dragons, waves and flowers covering the bare skin, dressed in the gang's red, black and white

Valentinos.blurb: Heywood's Latino gang, all gold, faith and family.
Valentinos.style: a member of a Latino street gang: a red and black patterned shirt or leather vest, gold-plated cyberarms, gold chains, a bandana or a cowboy hat, a thin mustache, white trousers

Voodoo Boys.blurb: Haitian netrunners who chase what lives past the Blackwall.
Voodoo Boys.style: a member of a Haitian netrunner gang: a long grey or purple-grey coat or vest over dark clothes, dreadlocks or a mohawk in pink or white, dark sunglasses, tech jewelry and data ports at the neck

Wraiths.blurb: Nomad outcasts who raid convoys in the Badlands.
Wraiths.style: a badlands raider: a sleeveless armored vest, a teal motorcycle helmet or a mohawk, a gas-mask respirator, teal and blue rags and accents, tattooed dusty arms

REO Meatwagon.blurb: The cut-rate ambulance outfit the city pays to take the calls Trauma Team won't, in ground rigs older than their crews.
REO Meatwagon.style: a paramedic of a cut-rate ambulance company: a worn high-visibility yellow field jacket with grey reflective stripes over cheap body armor, dark work trousers, tired eyes

Combat Cab.blurb: The armored taxi outfit that takes a fare anywhere in Night City, the Combat Zone included: "leave the combat to us."
Combat Cab.style: a battledriver of an armored taxi company with an uncovered, unmasked face: a dark blue mechanic's jumpsuit with red and white stripes across the chest, fingerless gloves, a hard street-worn look

aldecaldos-nomad.desc: An ordinary Aldecaldo rider: no legend, but a cut above the punks they meet on the city's edges. Usually seen on a big bike in the Badlands, sometimes in Pacifica for a job.
aldecaldos-nomad.look: young rider in a dusty duster coat and goggles pushed up, revolver on the hip

aldecaldos-gunslinger.desc: A seasoned Aldecaldo who leads small bands of riders into the city or takes contracts of their own. Well armed and lightly chromed; not corp-merc tough, but close enough.
aldecaldos-gunslinger.look: weathered gunslinger with a cyberarm, wide-brimmed hat and long leather coat

animals-gunner.desc: The bottom of the pack, trusted with only basic guns while they learn under tougher Animals. Some damage, little threat alone.
animals-gunner.look: young muscle-bound recruit with a cheap pistol, ripped sleeveless shirt, blond buzz cut, yellow tank top, blue track trousers

animals-raptor.desc: A Gunner good enough with firearms to earn a better one, which is rare for an Animal. Heavy sidearm, more chrome.
animals-raptor.look: thick-necked brute with a big heavy pistol, subdermal armor plating showing on the forearms, black mohawk, an open leather jacket over a bare chest

animals-bouncer.desc: The Gunner's counterpart: still bottom of the pack, but already doing the gang's real business of punching until it's over. Often works the door at clubs on the side.
animals-bouncer.look: huge bouncer in a tight black tee, scarred knuckles, earpiece, shaved head, neck tattoos

animals-mauler.desc: A better Bouncer, smart enough to wear a suit so clients see a professional. Light on armor, heavy on weapons.
animals-mauler.look: enormous bodybuilder squeezed into an expensive black suit, sleeves straining, brass knuckles, slicked-back black hair

animals-brutalizer.desc: Beats down anyone beneath them. The shotgun is just for the first hit before they close in.
animals-brutalizer.look: hulking brawler with a sawn-off shotgun over one shoulder, bloodied fists, bleached dreadlocks, a red hoodie with the sleeves ripped off

animals-jackhammer.desc: A Brutalizer pumped full of combat chrome, drugs and firepower; it takes power tools to crack one.
animals-jackhammer.look: titanic chromed brute with hydraulic pistons in the arms and a drug inhaler mask, bald, an implanted linear frame showing under the skin: ridged metal struts and pistons running along the spine, shoulders and arms beneath the muscle, with bolt heads and surgical seams breaking through the skin

animals-ogre.desc: A fist fighter in heavy armor, with neural boosters to get close before the autopistols run dry. Not bright, but tough.
animals-ogre.look: massive dim-eyed brute in heavy armor vest with twin machine pistols, green crew cut, an implanted linear frame showing under the skin: ridged metal struts and pistons running along the spine, shoulders and arms beneath the muscle, with bolt heads and surgical seams breaking through the skin

animals-undertaker.desc: One of the gang's ring champions, given designer drugs and combat chrome. No guns, and doesn't need them.
animals-undertaker.look: ring fighter with taped fists, championship belt, grafted muscle and swollen veins, long braided red hair, bare chest, wrestling trunks

animals-crusher.desc: A rare Animal who traded fists for a machine gun and plays backline support. Nobody knows why the pack lets them stay.
animals-crusher.look: massive gunner hauling a heavy machine gun with an ammo belt across the chest, a bandana over cornrows, camouflage trousers, an implanted linear frame showing under the skin: ridged metal struts and pistons running along the spine, shoulders and arms beneath the muscle, with bolt heads and surgical seams breaking through the skin

animals-thickskull.desc: The pack's best fighters: fast, hard to kill and proud of their title belts. They shun guns and crush skulls by hand.
animals-thickskull.look: champion pit fighter with a gold title belt, cauliflower ears, terrifying grin, bald with a braided beard, bare chest

arasaka-guard.desc: The lowest rung of Arasaka security, guarding corporate sites worldwide in gear barely better than the street's. They're the fodder before the real threat arrives, so stop them calling it in.
arasaka-guard.look: low-ranking guard in plain dark navy-black fatigues with a light chest rig of pouches and one small red shoulder tag, a rounded black helmet with a short brim and two small antenna fins, a black half-face mask and a padded collar ring around the neck, holding a pistol

arasaka-senior-guard.desc: A guard with better kit and a tailored armored suit for protection work that needs polish. The suit leaves the head exposed.
arasaka-senior-guard.look: sharply dressed guard with his black hair in a topknot and dark sunglasses, in a charcoal-black suit jacket over a crimson dress shirt, crimson leather gloves and an earpiece, no helmet

arasaka-ranger.desc: Corporate semi-soldiers with smart heavy SMGs and combat chrome. No subtlety; they shoot first.
arasaka-ranger.look: trooper in dark navy-black fatigues under a chest rig loaded with big pouches, a rounded black helmet with a short brim and two antenna fins, a black half-face respirator, a padded collar ring and red smart-link lenses, holding a smart heavy SMG

arasaka-soldier.desc: Arasaka's standard frontline soldier, well trained and milspec equipped, often leading squads of Guards or Rangers. Soldiers in numbers means something big.
arasaka-soldier.look: soldier in black padded combat armor with crimson gauntlets and gloves, black segmented shoulder pads, a thick padded black collar ring around the neck and jaw, layered black thigh guards hanging from the belt like samurai armor and baggy black trousers bloused into boots, a rounded crimson helmet with a short brim, a dark visor band, a black face mask and two short antenna fins at the back, holding a smart assault rifle

arasaka-assault-specialist.desc: Leads breaches and sieges from the front, soaking fire to end fights fast.
arasaka-assault-specialist.look: heavily armored breacher in black padded combat armor with crimson gauntlets and gloves, black segmented shoulder pads, a thick padded black collar ring around the neck and jaw, layered black thigh guards hanging from the belt like samurai armor and baggy black trousers bloused into boots, a rounded crimson helmet with a short brim, a dark visor band, a black face mask and two short antenna fins at the back, with extra black chest plates, grenades on the chest rig and a shotgun

arasaka-sniper.desc: Overwatch for high-value clients, with an excellent record. Slow to fire, rarely needs a second shot.
arasaka-sniper.look: sniper in dark navy-black padded fatigues with a short black shoulder cape, a rounded black helmet with two antenna fins and one telescopic lens over the eye, a black half-face mask and a padded collar ring, holding a long precision rifle

arasaka-elite-assault-specialist.desc: The specialists' specialist, sent to crack bunkers and fortified sites with heavy guns, chrome and explosives.
arasaka-elite-assault-specialist.look: bulky elite trooper in heavy black plated armor with crimson gauntlets, shoulder plates and thigh guards, a thick padded collar ring, a full crimson helmet with a sealed black faceplate, a red visor band and two antenna fins, carrying a heavy machine gun

arasaka-soldier-white-division.desc: Arasaka's little-known special forces, answering to the family and its executives. Fanatically loyal and equipped to put down traitors.
arasaka-soldier-white-division.look: elite soldier in a white-grey padded combat suit with a black chest rig, black gloves and a thick black padded collar ring, a rounded white helmet with a headset, a sealed white faceplate and small red markings, a katana at the hip

arasaka-bodyguard.desc: Personal security for executives who like to walk the streets. Well dressed, well chromed, very good at the job.
arasaka-bodyguard.look: enormous heavy-set sumo-sized bodyguard with a shaved head, in a black haori-style jacket with two round white crests on the chest over a crimson crossed-collar kimono shirt and black trousers, a smooth white porcelain face plate covering his face, chrome cybernetic hands

arasaka-netrunner.desc: One of the corp's poached, top-tier runners, equipped with the best gear and usually defending Arasaka's dataforts.
arasaka-netrunner.look: netrunner in a white-grey padded technician suit with a black chest rig and a thick black padded collar ring, a rounded white helmet with a headset and a visor of scrolling red code, interface cables at the neck, holding a data tablet

arasaka-assassin.desc: Quick, quiet and sent to kill, never to capture. Raised from nothing by the corp and loyal for it.
arasaka-assassin.look: lean woman assassin with a sharp black bob haircut and a chrome visor plate over her eyes, in a glossy black leather tailored suit over a crimson shirt, holding a short blade

arasaka-special-agent.desc: The 'saka cyberninja of street rumor, trained in secret in Japan in stealth and close combat. Used for jobs needing discretion, precision and speed.
arasaka-special-agent.look: cyberninja in a sleek black armored stealth suit with crimson gauntlets and a padded collar ring, a smooth black full-face mask with a glowing red visor slit and a mono-katana

arasaka-special-agent-mantis.desc: A Special Agent who'd rather fight with implants than carry weapons: blades built into the arms.
arasaka-special-agent-mantis.look: cyberninja in a sleek black armored stealth suit with crimson gauntlets and a padded collar ring, a smooth black full-face mask with a glowing red visor slit, in a low crouch with one arm reaching forward and the other arm drawn back behind; an implanted arm blade is deployed from inside each forearm: the forearm itself has split open along its outer side, its surface folded back as two panels around a dark open cavity inside the arm, and a short folding scissor linkage of two metal struts rises out of that cavity holding a long, slim, curved, single-edged polished steel scythe-like blade, as long as the whole arm, a hand's width above the arm; each blade runs parallel to its forearm with its blunt base above the elbow and its sharp tip pointing the same way as the fingers, sweeping on well past the fingertips; nothing is strapped onto the arms, no bracers; both hands are free, whole and empty, there are no other weapons, and the figure is drawn small enough that both blades fit inside the picture

arasaka-agent-executioner.desc: Freelancers Arasaka liked enough to hire full-time. Assassination and sabotage without much stealth, backed by heavy chrome.
arasaka-agent-executioner.look: cold mercenary with slicked-back hair and a chromed jaw, in a long glossy black leather coat over a crimson shirt, crimson leather gloves, a heavy pistol

arasaka-counter-intel-field-agent.desc: Counter-intelligence moles who live inside a group for months before striking. Nearly impossible to spot, and loaded with combat chrome once the cover drops.
arasaka-counter-intel-field-agent.look: unassuming person in a plain hoodie, one half of the face peeled back to reveal chrome and red optics

sandayu-oda.desc: Hanako Arasaka's personal bodyguard and one of the deadliest cyberninjas alive, with custom chrome most mercs never see. Honor drives him to fight alone, which a well-laid trap (with plenty of EMPs) might exploit.
sandayu-oda.look: a slim man in a black tactical combat suit with a high collar, a black chest rig with orange strap tabs and angular black shoulder plates with small white lettering, black hair swept to one side above a glowing red full-face cybernetic demon-face mask engraved with fine circuit lines, leaning forward mid-stride with both arms spread wide and low like wings; an implanted arm blade is deployed from inside each forearm: the forearm itself has split open along its outer side, its surface folded back as two panels around a dark open cavity inside the arm, and a short folding scissor linkage of two metal struts rises out of that cavity holding a long, slim, curved, single-edged red-hot glowing scythe-like blade, as long as the whole arm, a hand's width above the arm; each blade runs parallel to its forearm with its blunt base above the elbow and its sharp tip pointing the same way as the fingers, sweeping on well past the fingertips; nothing is strapped onto the arms, no bracers; both hands are free, whole and empty, there are no other weapons, and the figure is drawn small enough that both blades fit inside the picture; both blades glow from end to end like bars of bright red light

barghest-private.desc: Barghest's common muscle, recruited from green shooters with some loyalty and no morals. Bottom of the pack, but better kitted than a boostergang.
barghest-private.look: young militia private in a helmet spray-painted yellow-green with goggles pushed up, a black half-face respirator and an SMG

barghest-sergeant.desc: Small-time veterans and proven recruits who lead squads around Dogtown, keeping them on a leash while doing Hansen's dirty work.
barghest-sergeant.look: hardened woman squad sergeant, bare-headed with slicked-back black hair and thin cyberware lines on her face, a black neck gaiter, a radio handset and a heavy pistol

barghest-veteran-sergeant.desc: Squad leaders who've all been under fire and come out on top, now commanding heavier units guarding Barghest's key sites.
barghest-veteran-sergeant.look: grizzled veteran with a scarred face and a cybereye, a black helmet with ear protection and a tall antenna, a respirator hanging at the neck and an assault rifle

barghest-commando.desc: Veterans of Hansen's defecting commando unit, now trusted officers. Each wears a camera feeding Hansen's headquarters, so he sees everything.
barghest-commando.look: commando in a black helmet with a helmet camera and goggles, a full black respirator mask, compact SMG

barghest-punisher.desc: Simpler, blunter Commandos built for night patrols and dark corridors, with close-range guns and plainer chrome.
barghest-punisher.look: night-patrol soldier whose face is covered by a tight hood spray-painted with a crude yellow-green skull, with a combat shotgun and a flashlight on the shoulder

barghest-warrior.desc: Commandos who dropped the training for the underworld life: hand-to-hand fighters and interrogators who'd happily bite your face off.
barghest-warrior.look: scarred bare-headed brawler with sleeveless fatigues, dog tags, cyberarms streaked with yellow-green paint and a combat knife

barghest-sniper.desc: Marksmen with no rules of engagement holding overwatch over whole combat zones. Top-tier gear, little toughness; approach with caution or overwhelming firepower.
barghest-sniper.look: sniper in a paint-splashed hooded cloak and a black respirator with a long rifle and telescopic optics

barghest-veteran-sniper.desc: Better at everything a sniper does. Few exist, and you need a tank or plenty of fodder to draw their fire. Otherwise, hide.
barghest-veteran-sniper.look: veteran sniper in a yellow-green painted helmet with a telescopic cybereye lens, carrying a huge anti-materiel rifle

barghest-gunner.desc: A giant in superheavy armor with a gun to match, milspec chrome and ex-special-forces training. Short of a tank, among the toughest things in Night City.
barghest-gunner.look: giant in superheavy grey plated armor with huge square shoulder plates, an armored grey helmet with a white visor plate and a yellow-green painted mask, carrying a rotary heavy machine gun

kurt-hansen.desc: The former colonel who took Dogtown for the NUSA, was abandoned at war's end, and built his own homeland there on smuggling and arms deals. Warlord, deserter or liberator, depending on who you ask.
kurt-hansen.look: Kurt Hansen, the Barghest warlord: imposing middle-aged white man, shaved head, beard, heavy military greatcoat over armor, chrome cyberarms, commanding glare

generics-security-guard.desc: Rent-a-guards who work for whoever pays, holding a site or escorting someone against casual looters. Weak, but never alone.
generics-security-guard.look: bored security guard in grey uniform with a pistol and flashlight

generics-veteran-guard.desc: A guard with real combat time, better training or a fat gear budget, enough to put down punks who underestimate a corporate contract.
generics-veteran-guard.look: veteran guard with an armored vest, assault rifle and short grey hair

generics-heavy-guard.desc: Bigger, badder and beefier than the usual guard. No more skilled, but much harder to drop.
generics-heavy-guard.look: large heavyset guard in thick plated armor with a shotgun

generics-superheavy-guard.desc: Elite hired muscle for black sites: reinforced armor, extra chrome and heavy firepower, able to hold off a crowd almost alone.
generics-superheavy-guard.look: towering guard in full heavy armor and sealed helmet with a heavy machine gun

kang-tao-soldier.desc: Kang Tao's ordinary security troops. Less trained than real soldiers, but their smartguns, smart rounds and pain editors make up the gap.
kang-tao-soldier.look: trooper in orange hex-plate armor with a smart SMG

kang-tao-rapid-soldier.desc: Heavier guns, heavier armor and a harder attitude; the street nickname 'Rapid' stuck over the in-house 'assault specialist'.
kang-tao-rapid-soldier.look: assault trooper in heavier orange hex plating with a smart rifle

kang-tao-heavy.desc: Despite the name, a field commander running response teams from behind good armor and smart pistols.
kang-tao-heavy.look: commander in orange armor with a white command stripe with a smart pistol and a tactical holo display

lazarus-group-operator.desc: Back to being a PMC, Lazarus fields some of the world's best special forces for hire, and they may be stronger than they let on.
lazarus-group-operator.look: special-forces operator in black armor and respirator helmet with a suppressed rifle

maelstrom-scout.desc: Maelstrom's basic blade-wielders. Every member carries more chrome than other gangers, since initiation means losing their eyes, and sometimes a limb, awake.
maelstrom-scout.look: wiry ganger with a fresh red-optic cluster, a cyberleg and a machete

maelstrom-fanatic.desc: Scouts who took initiation better and earned a gun, usually whatever was lying nearby.
maelstrom-fanatic.look: manic ganger with red optics and a battered mismatched pistol

maelstrom-goon.desc: The gang's tougher rank-and-file, with more implants, combat drugs and bigger guns. All that chrome leaves them open to EMP.
maelstrom-goon.look: brutish goon with chrome jaw plate and red optic cluster holding an assault rifle

maelstrom-techie.desc: Backline cyber- and pyro-techs from Maelstrom's Ironfake workshops and 'recycling' clinics, sent out when a job needs a finer touch.
maelstrom-techie.look: techie with a multi-lens welding visor, tool harness and a grenade

maelstrom-maniac.desc: Muscle-grafted shotgunners in armored trenchcoats, the heavy hitters of small Maelstrom crews.
maelstrom-maniac.look: maniac in a long armored trenchcoat with a pump shotgun and red optics

maelstrom-zealot.desc: True believers who preach the gang's creed and police its members, usually with a partner. Not front-liners, but heavily chromed and experienced.
maelstrom-zealot.look: preacher-like zealot with a chrome skull face and red optics, cables like a priest's stole

maelstrom-ironstormer.desc: Hulking brutes of crude chrome and machine guns, used to make sure a deal goes Maelstrom's way and badly for everyone else.
maelstrom-ironstormer.look: hulking cyborg with crude welded armor plating and a belt-fed machine gun

maelstrom-fiend.desc: Laughing, screaming, and shooting; the gang at its most unhinged.
maelstrom-fiend.look: cackling psycho with a fully chromed face and red optics, wild eyes, twin guns

max-tac-heavy.desc: The biggest and toughest of the psycho squad, named for their size and near-impenetrable armor. Their guns are only a little lighter than the military's.
max-tac-heavy.look: giant MAX-TAC officer in massive black armor with a heavy machine gun

max-tac-mantis.desc: Faster than you, crazier than you, and built to cut you apart.
max-tac-mantis.look: MAX-TAC officer striking, one arm raised high overhead and the other held low at the hip; an implanted arm blade is deployed from inside each forearm: the forearm itself has split open along its outer side, its surface folded back as two panels around a dark open cavity inside the arm, and a short folding scissor linkage of two metal struts rises out of that cavity holding a long, slim, curved, single-edged polished steel scythe-like blade, as long as the whole arm, a hand's width above the arm; each blade runs parallel to its forearm with its blunt base above the elbow and its sharp tip pointing the same way as the fingers, sweeping on well past the fingertips; nothing is strapped onto the arms, no bracers; both hands are free, whole and empty, there are no other weapons, and the figure is drawn small enough that both blades fit inside the picture

melissa-rory.desc: A MAX-TAC lieutenant recruited after her own cyberpsychosis, now leading a team with a reputation for gore even among her peers. She'll dice a target, laugh, then give a press interview about saving the city.
melissa-rory.look: a woman in heavy black armor wearing a round black helmet fitted with four green-glowing goggle lenses, standing tall and still with both arms lowered at her sides and the blade tips pointing at the floor; an implanted arm blade is deployed from inside each forearm: the forearm itself has split open along its outer side, its surface folded back as two panels around a dark open cavity inside the arm, and a short folding scissor linkage of two metal struts rises out of that cavity holding a long, slim, curved, single-edged polished steel scythe-like blade, as long as the whole arm, a hand's width above the arm; each blade runs parallel to its forearm with its blunt base above the elbow and its sharp tip pointing the same way as the fingers, sweeping on well past the fingertips; nothing is strapped onto the arms, no bracers; both hands are free, whole and empty, there are no other weapons, and the figure is drawn small enough that both blades fit inside the picture

mercs-blazer.desc: A merc in their first weeks, burning fast and high without care for their own skin. Not inept, just green.
mercs-blazer.look: young eager merc in a flashy bomber jacket with a pistol

mercs-triggerman.desc: A merc who'll take any job but specializes in kill-or-capture work and gunplay.
mercs-triggerman.look: cold merc in a leather jacket with an SMG and a cybereye

mercs-hardened-triggerman.desc: A Triggerman with more fights, more gear and more wins; nearly a real cyberpunk.
mercs-hardened-triggerman.look: scarred merc in armored jacket with an assault rifle and chrome arm

mercs-merc.desc: The baseline professional: experienced, well-kitted killers for hire with a wide mix of fighting styles.
mercs-merc.look: professional merc in tactical streetwear with a rifle and visible chrome

mercs-street-scrapper.desc: Mercs raised in the life, who survived it with real fighting skill. Add a heavy smart shotgun and boosted reflexes and they're ready to prove themselves on anyone.
mercs-street-scrapper.look: street-tough merc with a smart shotgun, neon tattoos and a shaved head

mercs-support.desc: The biggest gun at the merc bar, carried by someone tough rather than refined. Holds up small teams with a scrapped-together heavy machine gun.
mercs-support.look: burly merc with a scrapped heavy machine gun and ammo belts

mercs-afterlife-merc.desc: Street punks who made it to a seat at Night City's top merc bar. Competent and experienced, but loyal mainly to the pay.
mercs-afterlife-merc.look: stylish edgerunner in a sleek jacket with chrome arms, leaning confident

mercs-afterlife-merc-pro.desc: The bar's real pros, running high-paying jobs for quiet clients with a near-perfect record. Close to legend status.
mercs-afterlife-merc-pro.look: elite edgerunner in a long tailored coat with a custom pistol and glowing optics

militech-recon-support.desc: Light, fast flankers with close-range guns, drawn from the most expendable recruits and nearly always backing heavier squadmates.
militech-recon-support.look: light infantry trooper with an SMG and lightweight armor

militech-infantry-scout.desc: The bulk of Militech's ground forces in Night City. Far better kitted than civilians of their level, and dangerous with numbers and support.
militech-infantry-scout.look: infantry soldier with an assault rifle and full helmet

militech-advanced-recon-support.desc: 'The best of the best', per Militech marketing: quick, heavily chromed troopers in elite units hunting fugitives and priority targets.
militech-advanced-recon-support.look: elite recon trooper with cybernetic legs and a compact rifle

militech-sharpshooter.desc: Roaming marksmen moving between positions for targets of opportunity, often attached to special ops.
militech-sharpshooter.look: marksman with a scoped rifle and telescopic cybereye

militech-commando.desc: Sent when an op must be clean, quiet and witness-free. Heavily chromed and trained for discreet, agile fighting.
militech-commando.look: stealth commando in dark armor with a suppressed weapon and optical camo shimmer

militech-heavy-gunner.desc: Militech's heavy weapons trooper, carrying the squad's biggest gun.
militech-heavy-gunner.look: heavily armored trooper with a heavy machine gun

ncpd-beat-cop.desc: The most basic police, securing crime scenes and running odd jobs. Not fighters, but the armory's gear helps.
ncpd-beat-cop.look: beat cop in navy uniform with a pistol and a cap

ncpd-patrol-officer.desc: The tougher, more experienced cops, and the badges you'll see most in Night City.
ncpd-patrol-officer.look: patrol officer in navy armor vest with a shotgun

ncpd-investigator.desc: Detectives sent to work a scene or chase a lead. Tougher than most cops because they work alone, but their mind is the main weapon.
ncpd-investigator.look: detective in a long coat with a badge on the belt and a scanning cybereye

ncpd-veteran-patrol-officer.desc: Officers who've seen the worst and are good at putting punks down. They work with tactical squads in the rough districts.
ncpd-veteran-patrol-officer.look: grizzled veteran cop with a scarred face and a heavy pistol

ncpd-heavy-patrol-officer.desc: SWAT on street patrol, rarely in quiet areas. A squad can turn up before MAX-TAC does.
ncpd-heavy-patrol-officer.look: SWAT officer in heavy navy armor and helmet with an assault rifle

ncpd-superheavy-patrol-officer.desc: When police reach a cyberpsycho before MAX-TAC, the armory hands its heaviest gear to those strong enough to carry it.
ncpd-superheavy-patrol-officer.look: superheavy police officer in bulky armor with a riot shield and heavy weapon

ncpd-tactical-officer.desc: SWAT leaders who keep the heaviest armor and guns for themselves, lead into dangerous calls, and like the kill credit.
ncpd-tactical-officer.look: SWAT commander with a full helmet visor raised and an assault rifle

netwatch-officer.desc: NetWatch's standard field agent, chromed and net-capable, usually with a partner in case things get hairy.
netwatch-officer.look: agent in a dark coat with temple implants glowing teal

netwatch-special-agent.desc: Leaders of NetWatch teams and major investigations, with the best netrunning chrome there is. Stay well away.
netwatch-special-agent.look: senior agent with an elaborate glowing neural crown implant and a cold stare

nusa-black-ops-operative.desc: You've never heard of them, and never will. Pulled from the NUSA's best units for its most clandestine missions, each picks a loadout for the job.
nusa-black-ops-operative.look: faceless black-ops operative in black armor and night-vision goggles

scavengers-thug.desc: Cheap, chrome-stealing, conscience-free gangsters who charge in with a growl, a grenade and a knife for carving afterwards. Never just one.
scavengers-thug.look: snarling thug with a bloody knife and a cheap tracksuit

scavengers-rat.desc: Slightly better scum with stolen gear that doesn't break on first use. Still can't shoot or protect themselves.
scavengers-rat.look: shifty ganger with a stolen pistol and a hooded jacket

scavengers-jackal.desc: Thugs with some chrome and conditioning, dangerous up close and quick to flank an ambushed target.
scavengers-jackal.look: lean ganger with cyber-legs and a machete

scavengers-hyena.desc: What Jackals want to be: more combat implants and reflex boosters, always hunting in packs.
scavengers-hyena.look: vicious grinning ganger with reflex implants and twin blades

scavengers-crow.desc: A Rat who survived a few fights, upgraded the gun, grabbed a grenade and some drugs. Supports from the back.
scavengers-crow.look: ganger with a bigger pistol, a grenade on the belt and a drug inhaler

scavengers-hound.desc: The harder muscle of a scav crew, with more stolen chrome and heavier guns. Not a big threat, but lethal if ignored.
scavengers-hound.look: heavyset ganger with a shotgun and stolen cyberarm

scavengers-cur.desc: A thug who found a bigger gun and learned to fight, and now keeps the other scavs in line, as far as anyone can.
scavengers-cur.look: scarred enforcer with an assault rifle and gold teeth

scavengers-spider.desc: A rare netrunner scav who trawls forums for targets and disables prey for the crew. Easy kill up close; dangerous until then.
scavengers-spider.look: pale netrunner with a jury-rigged cyberdeck and cables in the neck

scavengers-vulture.desc: The crew's biggest bruiser, with heavy guns and thick clothing. No match for milspec, but plenty for green crews or civilians.
scavengers-vulture.look: big bruiser in a padded jacket with a heavy weapon

scavengers-sniper.desc: A chromed hunter who stalks for hours and rarely misses. Catch them between shots and hit back hard.
scavengers-sniper.look: chromed sniper with a heavy rifle and a telescopic cybereye

trauma-team-medic.desc: The heart of Trauma Team: superbly equipped and trained to undo almost any fatal injury, for subscribers. Not fighters, but don't underestimate them.
trauma-team-medic.look: Trauma Team medic with a medical kit and drug injector

trauma-team-pilot.desc: AV pilots who thread skyscrapers at 200 mph. Light in a fight, but their armed, armored AV makes up for it.
trauma-team-pilot.look: Trauma Team pilot in a flight suit with a large avionics helmet

trauma-team-support.desc: The gunners of a Trauma Team unit, with top smartguns, grenades, combat chrome and a license to shoot whoever gets in the way.
trauma-team-support.look: Trauma Team gunner with a smart assault rifle

trauma-team-assault-specialist.desc: Combat pros hired to escort Trauma Team into the worst districts. Not medics; paid escorts.
trauma-team-assault-specialist.look: heavily armored Trauma Team escort with a heavy rifle

tyger-claws-hunter.desc: New Tyger Claws recruits. A stick and an intimidating mask, but not the predators the gang is known for.
tyger-claws-hunter.look: young recruit with blue hair shaved at the sides, a green oni half-mask over the mouth and nose, in a red quilted biker leather suit with green trim and a high collar, holding a baton

tyger-claws-tyger.desc: The everyday Tyger Claw: screams, charges with a blade or SMG, and definitely isn't paid by Arasaka.
tyger-claws-tyger.look: lean man with slicked-back white hair in a grey tank top with pink trim, a black jacket tied around the waist, goggles hanging at the neck and padded biker trousers, both arms and chest tattooed, holding a katana

tyger-claws-racketeer.desc: Talented Tygers the gang sponsors, leading crews that collect protection money from 'clients'.
tyger-claws-racketeer.look: slick woman racketeer with black hair in a ponytail and a pink mirrored visor band over her eyes, in a white pinstripe blazer with rolled sleeves and a red skirt, tattooed arms, holding a pistol

tyger-claws-thug.desc: Tougher bruisers brought along when a client needs persuading; they prefer to hit hard up close.
tyger-claws-thug.look: burly bare-chested thug with swept-back purple-blue hair shaved at the sides, a red oni half-mask with gold fangs over the mouth, one glossy red cyberarm with a gold forearm, and a baseball bat

tyger-claws-ozeki.desc: Door-wide bodyguards for gang leaders. Brutal hand-to-hand, not bright.
tyger-claws-ozeki.look: massive sumo-built bodyguard with a topknot, bare tattooed chest and arms, a red sash and black biker trousers, fists raised

tyger-claws-ozeki-prime.desc: Ozeki who've proven themselves, dressed to impress for important clients. Still tanks that hit hard.
tyger-claws-ozeki-prime.look: massive sumo-built bodyguard with a topknot in a dazzling red silk jacket embroidered with a gold tiger, worn open over a tattooed chest

tyger-claws-jonin.desc: Information brokers and datafort defenders. Weak in a straight fight, but they keep the Tygers aware of everything on their turf.
tyger-claws-jonin.look: netrunner with a pink mirrored visor band over the eyes and interface cables at the neck, in a red and white kimono-cut biker jacket laced with cables

tyger-claws-dragon.desc: Heavy hitters with big guns and chrome beyond most gangers, used as hitmen or bodyguards when blades won't do.
tyger-claws-dragon.look: fierce ganger with spiked white hair in an open red quilted biker jacket over a chest tattooed with a dragon, holding a big shotgun

tyger-claws-blitzer.desc: Dragons who prefer it close: fanatics who enforce gang loyalty and are lethal in a fight.
tyger-claws-blitzer.look: frenzied bare-chested fighter with blue hair, a red oni half-mask with gold fangs and a tattooed torso, charging with a katana raised

tyger-claws-adept.desc: Blade dancers climbing the ranks with skill and no self-preservation, rewarded with chrome by their mentors.
tyger-claws-adept.look: graceful woman swordfighter with her black hair in a tight bun and white face paint with red around the eyes, in a glossy black and red bodysuit, one gold cyberarm, drawing a katana

tyger-claws-kunoichi.desc: The street's answer to a corporate cyberninja: a chrome blur that hunts the gang's toughest enemies. Light hitters, but good luck landing a blow.
tyger-claws-kunoichi.look: agile woman cyberninja with her hair in a tight bun and a red mask over the lower face, in a glossy red and black bodysuit with bare tattooed arms, lunging to one side with one arm stretched straight out ahead of her and the other arm trailing straight out behind her; an implanted arm blade is deployed from inside each forearm: the forearm itself has split open along its outer side, its surface folded back as two panels around a dark open cavity inside the arm, and a short folding scissor linkage of two metal struts rises out of that cavity holding a long, slim, curved, single-edged polished steel scythe-like blade, as long as the whole arm, a hand's width above the arm; each blade runs parallel to its forearm with its blunt base above the elbow and its sharp tip pointing the same way as the fingers, sweeping on well past the fingertips; nothing is strapped onto the arms, no bracers; both hands are free, whole and empty, there are no other weapons, and the figure is drawn small enough that both blades fit inside the picture

valentinos-gangoon.desc: The gang's basic shooters: plenty of style, decent guns, little self-preservation. Guns and jewelry painted to look pricier than they are.
valentinos-gangoon.look: young gangster with gold chains and a gold-painted pistol

valentinos-seasoned-thug.desc: The gang's rough-and-tumble fighters, always ready to prove their loyalty. Brave more than skilled.
valentinos-seasoned-thug.look: tough thug with a rosary, saint tattoos and a machete

valentinos-sanguinario.desc: Bloodthirsty low-rank shooters with heavier guns and a little training, laying down walls of fire with the Gangoons.
valentinos-sanguinario.look: gangster with an SMG, gold teeth and saint tattoos

valentinos-brutal-sanguinario.desc: Sanguinarios given special training for their loyalty, with unusual weapons and some chrome. Not as good as they think, but hard-hitting.
valentinos-brutal-sanguinario.look: brutal gangster with an ornate gold-plated rifle and a cyberarm

valentinos-guerrero.desc: The gang's true loyalists and field commanders, good with many weapons and fierce about keeping everyone in line.
valentinos-guerrero.look: commanding gangster in a cream suit with gold chains and a pistol

valentinos-maton.desc: Cold-hearted bodyguards for the gang's interests, using cyber-armor and melee skill to keep everyone at a distance.
valentinos-maton.look: intimidating bodyguard with subdermal armor and a gold-handled knife

valentinos-macho.desc: Fast-rising up-and-comers who fight well and know it, thanks mostly to neural boosters. They'll tell you it's all skill.
valentinos-macho.look: cocky young gangster with slicked hair, gold chains and twin pistols

valentinos-toro.desc: The gang's toughest muscle: they'll throw you down, cut you up, and still want more.
valentinos-toro.look: bull-necked brute with a bull tattoo and a big blade

valentinos-sicario.desc: Rumored ex-corp solos or enforcers from the south. Deadly, heavily chromed, fast and hard to hit.
valentinos-sicario.look: lethal assassin in an elegant maroon suit with chrome arms and a silenced pistol

voodoo-boys-malfini.desc: The newest Voodoo Boys: untrained and poorly equipped but plentiful, with some neural hardening against other runners.
voodoo-boys-malfini.look: young man in Pacifica streetwear with ritual face paint and a pistol

voodoo-boys-fierce-malfini.desc: Voodoo Boys based in Dogtown, tougher and better armed for the neighborhood. They mostly stay there.
voodoo-boys-fierce-malfini.look: hardened fighter with ritual tattoos and an SMG

voodoo-boys-spirit.desc: Quiet, stealthy Malfini who strike from behind. Dangerous in numbers or by surprise.
voodoo-boys-spirit.look: hooded figure with glowing cyber-eyes and a knife, half in shadow

voodoo-boys-netrunner.desc: The gang's basic runners, layered with ICE and a lethal program list. Sent into fights with Malfini and Spirits; they favor deadly quickhacks.
voodoo-boys-netrunner.look: netrunner with glowing data cables at the temples and ritual beads

voodoo-boys-snakecharmer.desc: The gang's meatspace hitters, because a good runner never relies on the Net alone. They lead Malfini and Spirits.
voodoo-boys-snakecharmer.look: fighter with a snake tattoo coiling up the neck and a shotgun

voodoo-boys-manbo.desc: Net-savant runners given command of sects or key territory. They can drop most threats with a thought; rush them before they do.
voodoo-boys-manbo.look: priestess-like netrunner in white robes with a glowing neural crown and ritual beads

voodoo-boys-punisher.desc: Dogtown Voodoo Boys modeled on Hansen's militia to resist a siege: fast, hard-hitting and hard to pin down, despite the casual clothes.
voodoo-boys-punisher.look: casually dressed fighter with an assault rifle and ritual tattoos

wraiths-marauder.desc: An exile with a scavenged SMG, a knife and a grudge against the nomad clans. Weak alone, but never alone.
wraiths-marauder.look: raider with a scrap-metal shoulder plate and a battered SMG

wraiths-devil.desc: Marauders exiled later in life, with more fights behind them and the same shabby gear.
wraiths-devil.look: raider with skull war paint and a rusty shotgun

wraiths-bane.desc: The bane of convoys: capable fighters with implants for fast, deadly ambushes.
wraiths-bane.look: raider with cyberlegs and goggles mid-ambush pose

wraiths-ghoul.desc: Field officers and enforcers who get Wraith bands to follow orders. Not tough, and never at the front.
wraiths-ghoul.look: gaunt raider with a skull mask and a radio

wraiths-sniper.desc: Snipers with salvaged Militech rifles that hole engine blocks as readily as skulls.
wraiths-sniper.look: raider sniper with a salvaged military rifle and dust goggles

wraiths-goliath.desc: Leaders of whole Wraith bands: hulking, chromed, drugged and armed, wading through gunfire to raid another convoy.
wraiths-goliath.look: hulking raider warlord in scrap armor with a machine gun and a horned skull helmet

reo-meatwagon-paramedic.desc: Twelve-hour shifts, a cryobag and a jacket that reports back to the company. Some of them still try to get you there alive.
reo-meatwagon-paramedic.look: carrying a medical bag, a breathing mask pushed up on the forehead

reo-meatwagon-driver.desc: Knows every alley a box ambulance fits down, and keeps a shotgun racked behind the seat for the people who jump the rig for its drugs.
reo-meatwagon-driver.look: a stocky ambulance driver in an orange high-visibility jacket and a cap, holding a pump shotgun

reo-meatwagon-senior-medtech.desc: The one on the crew who has seen it all and can still close a wound in a moving rig. Whether you reach the hospital is another matter.
reo-meatwagon-senior-medtech.look: an older veteran medic with grey stubble, blue visor glasses and surgical gloves, an airhypo in hand

reo-meatwagon-hired-gun.desc: A solo on a day rate who rides along since crews started getting jumped. Paid to keep the rig moving, not to care who is in the back.
reo-meatwagon-hired-gun.look: a hired gunman in a yellow high-visibility vest over a light armor jacket, holding an assault rifle

combat-cab-battledriver.desc: Ex-nomad, ex-merc or ex-corp, now driving an armored cab through whatever is between you and your stop. The meter runs during firefights.
combat-cab-battledriver.look: leaning on an armored orange-yellow taxi door, a heavy pistol holstered on the chest

combat-cab-shotgun-rider.desc: Rides up front on the bad runs. Their whole job is to make sure nobody stops the cab.
combat-cab-shotgun-rider.look: a broad-shouldered guard with a shaved head, holding a pump shotgun

combat-cab-veteran-battledriver.desc: Has been running the Combat Zone for years and has the scars and the regulars to prove it. Takes the fares nobody else will.
combat-cab-veteran-battledriver.look: a scarred older driver with a cybernetic eye, an assault rifle slung across the back

sasquatch.desc: Combat Cab's legend: a driver sculpted head to toe into a sasquatch who has never lost a fare, a race or an argument about the route. Dispatch sends him maybe once in a thousand calls. If Bigfoot pulls up, get in.
sasquatch.look: an enormous driver with a full sasquatch body sculpt: a towering ape-like frame covered in shaggy dark brown fur, a heavy brow and a calm weathered face, mirrored aviator sunglasses, the jumpsuit's sleeves torn off over huge furry arms, fingerless driving gloves
